nodes.title: 🚀 Quick Start
widgets_values:
🚀  QUICK START

1. Install custom nodes (see Custom Nodes note)
2. Download all models from HuggingFace links (6 files, gated)
3. Verify model paths match widget defaults (no absolute paths)
4. Set folder_path on Batch Image Loader OR drag image into LoadImage
5. Adjust orientation (auto-detect runs by default)
6. Click Queue

Requires ComfyUI >= 0.30

Frame count: 121f = 5.0s @ 24fps (N×8+1 pattern)
Alternates: 169f = 7.0s, 241f = 10.0s

nodes.title: 🖥️ Hardware
widgets_values:
🖥️  HARDWARE

Minimum: 16GB VRAM (with model offload)
Recommended: 24GB+ VRAM for >169 frames
Audio VAE concurrency: sequential (no co-resident audio+video decode)
VRAM bridge: soft flushes between stage1→stage2

nodes.title: 🔊 Audio
widgets_values:
🔊  AUDIO

Video is generated with native stereo audio from the LTX-2.5
joint latent space.

To mute: disconnect the audio wire from CreateVideo before queueing.

Audio VAE is separate from video VAE.

nodes.title: 📊 Two-Stage Architecture
widgets_values:
📊  TWO-STAGE DIFFUSION  (distilled LTX-2.5)

**Stage 1: Fast generation**
- 8-step diffusion (distilled model)
- 960×544 landscape / 544×960 portrait
- Produces video_latent + audio_latent

**Stage 2: Upscale + refine**
- 2x spatial upscaler (1920×1088 out)
- 3-step re-diffusion (refinement)
- Image conditioning re-applied
- Final decode via video VAE + audio VAE

nodes.title: 📖 Quick Guide
widgets_values:
## LTX-2.5 I2V AUTO v1.0 — Quick Guide

**First time setup:**
1. Box 🧠 1. MODELS — verify all loaders point to valid files (one-time check)
2. Box 🖼️ 2. IMAGE INPUT — drag your photo into "SOURCE IMAGE" OR set folder_path on Batch Image Loader
3. Box 🎲 3. SEED & SAMPLER — change seeds if you want (stages separate)
4. Box 📝 5. MOTION TEXT — pick Auto or Manual (auto uses QwenVL vision caption)
5. Click Queue to run

**Common edits:** Seed (box 3, two separate seeds) | Source image (box 2) | Frame count (box 4, INTERNALS) | Motion text (box 5) | Orientation (auto-detect)

**Notes:** Two-stage architecture (8+3 steps) | 121 frames = 5.0s @ 24fps (default) | Audio is joint with video | No LoRA/turbo needed — distilled model is built-in

**VRAM management:** soft flush between stage1→stage2, separate audio/video VAE decode

At nine seconds, a forward-facing helmet camera shows only the handlebars, windscreen, and rushing road as the bike accelerates out of the bend. At twelve seconds, a low rear chase angle follows the rear tire and exhaust through heat shimmer and a sharp exhaust crack, then at fifteen seconds a roadside camera pans with the motorcycle as it blasts across the frame. At eighteen seconds, a final high rear aerial view watches the bike race toward the glowing horizon while the engine and wind fade naturally.
